enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Poisonous 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with a vile venom, dealing 4d6 poison damage on each hit.
Critical Befouling 2: This deadly weapon saps the charm from your enemies, dealing 2 Charisma damage on each critical hit.
Doubleshot 5%: Passive: 5% Enhancement bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
